name: [R4] Server-zone host contacting a messaging API (possible C2)
message:
Outbound to a messaging platform API (Telegram/Discord/Slack/Signal) from a server/production host. Hermes-style orchestration can use messaging as a C2/report channel. Verify against approved ChatOps integrations; if none, treat as suspected C2 and contain.

Tune: define @network.client.zone; allowlist approved alerting integrations.

queries.name: messaging_egress
queries.query: source:(proxy OR firewall OR dns) @network.destination.name:(api.telegram.org OR discord.com OR discordapp.com OR hooks.slack.com OR slack.com) @network.client.zone:(server OR production OR dmz)
